basics.name: Ahmet Bedir
basics.label: Senior Lead Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Lead Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building and scaling SaaS, marketplace and e-commerce platforms with PHP and Laravel. Leads the engineering team behind a multi-channel commerce platform integrating 65+ sales channels and 25+ 3PL and logistics providers, processing millions of orders and events every day. Strong in system architecture, queue-driven processing, performance tuning and production incident analysis. Ships LLM-powered features in production and uses AI coding agents daily across development, code review and operations. Open to remote roles and relocation.
basics.pitch: I lead the engineering team behind a multi-channel commerce platform that connects retailers to 90+ marketplaces, carts and logistics providers, and I bring AI into both the product and the way the team builds it.

work.name: The Despatch Company
work.summary: Leading development of Neuro (heyneuro.io), the company's multi-channel e-commerce integration platform (iPaaS) that keeps products, stock, orders and fulfilments in sync between retailers and their marketplaces, carts, accounting and logistics systems.
highlights: Team lead of the Neuro engineering team (code review, task planning, release management) on a Laravel, PostgreSQL and Redis platform, owning architecture decisions and production stability.

Built and maintained integrations with Amazon SP-API and Vendor Central, eBay, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Etsy, Walmart, Mirakl, Magento, Medusa and QuickBooks Online, plus 25+ 3PL and logistics integrations.

Shipped AI features in Neuro with LLM agents using tool calling and structured output: built AI-assisted SKU mapping that suggests matches between channel and catalogue products, and led delivery of natural-language rule and report builders that turn plain-English requests into automation rules and scheduled reports.

Run high-volume, queue-driven processing of millions of orders, stock updates and events a day; improved performance through query, queue and caching optimisations (including a ~38% faster rule engine), led major PHP and Laravel upgrades and drive root-cause analysis of production incidents.
Automated multi-server deployments with zero-downtime queue handling, led a cloud object storage migration and started a ClickHouse-based archiving initiative to keep the primary database lean.

Built AI developer tooling for the team: an MCP server that connects Claude Code to Jira, Freshdesk, Sentry and Horizon, and an application that reviews pull requests against their Jira tasks and manages release candidates and branches. Contributed to the Nuxt 2 to Next.js and React frontend migration.

work.name: The Despatch Company
work.summary: Worked across the company's product suite: Helm WMS (e-commerce order and warehouse management), Voila (multi-courier shipping platform), the Tracking API and the rydale.com e-commerce platform.
highlights: Developed features for Helm WMS (helmwms.com), the company's multi-channel order and warehouse management system for e-commerce, during the first months.
Built courier integrations for Voila (heyvoila.io), the company's multi-courier shipping platform that now connects businesses to 160+ couriers through a single integration.
Worked on the Tracking API, delivering shipment tracking and branded customer-facing tracking and returns pages.
Developed the rydale.com e-commerce platform from scratch over a long-running project, covering architecture, catalogue, ordering flows and integrations through to launch.

work.name: Tek Kılavuz Digital Performance Agency
work.summary: Developed custom e-commerce platforms, CRM applications, and business automation software for agency clients.
highlights: Delivered high-performance e-commerce platforms and custom web applications using PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, Vue.js, and MySQL.
Built tailored CRM and business automation systems to streamline client sales, reporting, and operational workflows.
Administered Linux hosting environments, optimised web servers and database queries, and ensured high availability across client projects.

work.name: Sisoft Healthcare Information Systems
work.summary: Provided technical support, troubleshooting, and operational maintenance for hospital information management systems.
highlights: Diagnosed and resolved production software and database issues for hospital information systems, working with engineering teams to improve uptime and stability.
